title: Every Quantum Run Needs a Referee — reproduction package
description: Experiment scripts, raw results (including IBM Quantum job identifiers, the raw counts of the hardware rounds from round 2 on and the calibration snapshots of round 8), solver modules and LaTeX source for the paper 'Every Quantum Run Needs a Referee: Design and Empirical Lessons from a Vendor-Neutral Hybrid Quantum-Classical Platform'. Version 2.1.0 covers experiments E1 to E32 on seven workloads: amplitude estimation against classical Monte Carlo with the Cramer-Rao bound; facility location against an exact MILP referee; Rydberg MIS mappings with a tuned control; sample-based diagonalization (SqDRIFT and SQD) against random strings, an FCI-weight oracle and selected CI; vehicle routing; QAOA evaluated exactly; portfolio selection (QAOA, CVaR-VQE, PCE, BF-DCQO) against the exact optimum and uniform nulls; mission resource allocation against an exact MILP referee, a greedy baseline and uniform bitstrings at an equal number and at equal time; and eight hardware rounds on three IBM Heron processors (ibm_marrakesh, ibm_kingston, ibm_fez). New since version 2.0.1: hardware rounds 4 to 8, the mission workload with its solver modules, and a paper that reports the platform as it stands. CHANGES.md says what changed from version to version and keeps the record of corrections to earlier versions, which remain available.
